title: MarineTraffic Speed Drop Near Port
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marinetraffic:vessel
| stats avg(speed_knots) as avg_speed_knots, min(speed_knots) as min_speed_knots by vessel_name port_name
| where avg_speed_knots>0 AND min_speed_knots<3
| sort min_speed_knots
description: Uses MarineTraffic vessel speed telemetry to monitor port approaches where vessels slow sharply in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for docking or congestion patterns near favorite ports, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MarineTraffic vessel speed data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vessel and port table of minimum speed.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates port approaches where vessels slow sharply so you can spot docking or congestion patterns near favorite ports before it becomes annoying.
